yoshi.text: Skip to content SPORTMYFITNESSTO GAIN, MAINTAIN, OR LOSE IT ALL TAKES WORK Menu TrainingAboutMedia Community Let’s train Portrait from her Facebook profile ↗ MILWAUKEE · SPORT MY FITNESS MEETYOSHI. Coach. Athlete. Community builder. Yoshi “Myosha” Barnes. Rooted in Milwaukee. Let’s train → Portrait from her Facebook profile ↗ EMPOWER THE BODY. STRENGTHEN THE MIND. THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORKFROM THE COURT.TO THE COMMUNITY. Her story spans college basketball, fitness entrepreneurship and community work. Milwaukee is the thread that runs through it. COLLEGE BASKETBALLON THE COURT.Before Sport My Fitness, Myosha Barnes played guard at San José State and Missouri Southern. Both university rosters list Milwaukee as her hometown.San José State · 2006–07Missouri Southern · 2008–09 SPORT MY FITNESS · EST. 2015BUILDING IN MILWAUKEE.Sport My Fitness was established in 2015. She is a certified fitness trainer and strength & conditioning coach. Her qualifications include ISSA certification and an MBA in sports management. YOUTH & COMMUNITYSHOWING UP.In September 2026, she shared her work with young people at the American Indian School, bringing fitness and encouragement beyond the gym. Her school work has also included Pathways High, Whitefish Bay High School and Bader Hillel High School. THE SPORT MY FITNESS COMMUNITYPhoto: Social X · 2024 event archive ↗ IN HER WORDS“Anytime I get an opportunity to support our youth,I’m going to show up.”YOSHI BARNESFrom her September 2, 2026 post ↗ STAY CONNECTEDKEEP CONNECTING.Instagram ↗Facebook ↗YouTube ↗ YOUR NEXT STEPIN MOTION.Videos, gym moments and community. blocks: EMPOWER THE BODY. STRENGTHEN THE MIND.
Her story spans college basketball, fitness entrepreneurship and community work. Milwaukee is the thread that runs through it.
Before Sport My Fitness, Myosha Barnes played guard at San José State and Missouri Southern. Both university rosters list Milwaukee as her hometown.
Sport My Fitness was established in 2015. She is a certified fitness trainer and strength & conditioning coach. Her qualifications include ISSA certification and an MBA in sports management.

In September 2026, she shared her work with young people at the American Indian School, bringing fitness and encouragement beyond the gym. Her school work has also included Pathways High, Whitefish Bay High School and Bader Hillel High School.
THE SPORT MY FITNESS COMMUNITYPhoto: Social X · 2024 event archive ↗
“Anytime I get an opportunity to support our youth,I’m going to show up.”YOSHI BARNES
